thread:
Maya (CS): FYI AtlasGrid renewal — procurement wants split billing across their APAC and EMEA entities and separate signers. renewal is in 4 weeks.
Liam (AM): do we have an internal playbook for multi-entity renewals? last quarter this added a week to the cycle.
Hannah (Sales): we do a) two amendments referencing the same master, or b) one amendment + billing appendix. legal prefers (a). sales fine with either as long as pricing doesn't change.
Noah (Finance): split billing ok but we need vendor codes, billing addresses, and tax ids for both entities. Also need to know which currency they prefer for each invoice.
Maya (CS): procurement clarified: APAC pays in SGD via APAC entity, EMEA pays in EUR via EMEA entity. APAC signer: "Kenji Watanabe" (VP Finance APAC). EMEA signer: "Sofia Martinez" (CFO EMEA).
Priya (Legal): confirmed: two amendments is cleaner for audit. i'll prepare two short amendments that mirror each other and reference master agreement MG-2020-017. include standard non-cross-liability clause. need full legal names and email addresses for envelope routing.
Liam (AM): i'll confirm emails. quick ask: can we keep unified pricing (no seat-level split) and just allocate seat counts per entity?
Hannah (Sales): yes, price per seat unchanged. seat split proposed: APAC 15 seats, EMEA 35 seats. total 50. we can offer prorated billing to align renewals if needed.
Noah (Finance): prefer quarterly invoices but client requested monthly. we can accept monthly for first 6 months then evaluate. note: different currencies require FX handling on our side.
Maya (CS): procurement also asked if DocuSign can require separate delegated signatures and still mark both as executed only when both envelopes complete. any limit?
DocuSign Bot: DocuSign supports related envelopes and combined completion tracking. recommend setting "collect signatures" on both and enable "status webhook" so Redwood's contracts system marks contract as executed only when both envelopes complete. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Legal): drafting now. will include clause: "This Amendment applies solely to the entity identified herein and shall not bind any other entity of Customer." Also adding signature block language for delegated signatories.
Liam (AM): received emails from AtlasGrid: Kenji (kenji@atlasgrid-apac.com), Sofia (sofia@atlasgrid-emea.com). vendor codes: APAC: AG-AP-332, EMEA: AG-EM-778. VAT/EIN provided in email thread. forwarding to Finance.
Noah (Finance): got it. uploading vendor codes and updated billing info to the vendor template: https://drive.redwood.ai/finance/vendor-templates/atlasgrid-vendor-info-1708521111.pdf
Maya (CS): great. next steps: Priya to drop amendments, Noah to confirm billing cadence (we'll propose monthly for 6 months), Liam to upload final countersign emails, and i'll set up DocuSign related envelopes. deadline: get executed by renewal date in 4 weeks.
Priya (Legal): amendments will be in /contracts/AtlasGrid/renewals/1708521111/ as amendment_APAC.pdf and amendment_EMEA.pdf. tag me when files are uploaded so i can do a final legal stamp.
Maya (CS): tagging @DocuSign Bot — please prepare related envelopes once PDFs are in place.
DocuSign Bot: will monitor folder and create related envelopes when files present. will send status updates to this channel. :robot_face:
Hannah (Sales): i'll offer a 1.5% early-pay incentive if they commit to net-30 for each entity and sign within 7 days of receipt. little nudge to accelerate.
Liam (AM): copying procurement thread with the payment incentive. AtlasGrid responded: they accept monthly for now but will try to switch to quarterly after first quarter.
Noah (Finance): ack. i'll provision monthly billing schedules and FX routing.
Maya (CS): thanks everyone — please post when amendments are uploaded. we'll track the execution in the renewal tracker.
